GAME SENSE — QUESTION REVIEW

32 questions · 3/32 with art · green = correct answer · EN + 中文 shown together

评审用：圈出要改的题/选项/解析，或要重出的图。English 默认面向终端用户，中文为可切备选。

#1 CORE DESIGN BASIC 1.1
What is a game's "core loop"?
什么是游戏的「核心循环 (core loop)」？
  • ✓ The short repeating sequence of actions a player does most of the time玩家绝大部分时间反复执行的那段短动作序列
  • The opening cutscene that plays once只在开场播一次的过场动画
  • The final boss fight最终 Boss 战
  • The credits screen结算名单画面
WHY Core loop = the do-it-again unit (aim→shoot→reward→repeat). Everything else wraps around it. 核心循环就是"再来一次"的最小单元，其余系统都包在它外面。
#2 CORE DESIGN BASIC 1.2
ART TO GENERATE
A new player should ideally understand a scroll-feed mini-game within roughly…
在信息流里刷到的小游戏，新玩家理想情况下应在大约多久内看懂？
  • ✓ A couple of seconds, with no tutorial几秒内，且不需要教程
  • 2–3 minutes after reading instructions读完说明后 2–3 分钟
  • After completing a settings step做完设置步骤之后
  • After a mandatory account signup强制注册账号之后
WHY Zero-context, near-zero patience: self-explanatory UI beats explanatory text. 零上下文、近乎零耐心，自解释的 UI 胜过解释性文案。
#3 CORE DESIGN ADVANCED 1.3
ART TO GENERATE
Which reward schedule tends to be the most engaging (and habit-forming)?
哪种奖励节奏通常最能吸引人（也最易养成习惯）？
  • ✓ Variable / intermittent reward可变（间歇）奖励
  • Fixed reward every single action每个动作都给固定奖励
  • No reward at all完全不给奖励
  • One reward only at the very end只在最末尾给一次奖励
WHY Variable ratio reinforcement is the strongest driver of repeat behavior. 可变比率强化是重复行为最强的驱动力。
#4 CORE DESIGN ADVANCED 1.4
ART TO GENERATE
"Difficulty curve" problems most often show up as…
「难度曲线」问题最常表现为……
  • ✓ A sudden spike or a flat boring stretch突然的陡峰，或一段平坦无聊的区间
  • Too many color choices颜色选项太多
  • A long credits sequence过长的结算名单
  • Small file size文件体积太小
WHY Good pacing ramps challenge smoothly; spikes frustrate, flats bore. 好的节奏让难度平滑爬升；陡峰让人挫败，平坦让人无聊。
#5 CORE DESIGN BASIC 1.5
ART TO GENERATE
"Game feel" / "juice" mainly refers to…
「手感 / juice」主要指……
  • ✓ The immediate sensory feedback that makes actions feel satisfying让动作"爽"的即时感官反馈
  • The price of the game游戏售价
  • The number of levels关卡数量
  • The size of the dev team团队规模
WHY Juice = the layer of feedback (shake, particles, sound) on top of mechanics. juice 是叠在机制之上的反馈层（震屏、粒子、音效）。
#6 CORE DESIGN ADVANCED 1.6
ART TO GENERATE
"Flow state" is best sustained when challenge is…
当难度处于什么状态时，最能维持「心流 (flow)」？
  • ✓ Balanced just above the player's current skill略高于玩家当前技能、保持平衡
  • Far above the player's skill远高于玩家技能
  • Far below the player's skill远低于玩家技能
  • Random and unpredictable完全随机不可预测
WHY Too hard → anxiety, too easy → boredom; flow sits in between. 太难→焦虑，太易→无聊，心流在两者之间。
#7 CORE DESIGN BASIC 1.7
ART TO GENERATE
The best way to teach a game's first mechanic is usually…
教会玩家游戏第一个机制，通常最好的方式是……
  • ✓ Let them do it once in a safe, guided moment (learning by doing)在安全、被引导的瞬间让他们先做一次（做中学）
  • Show a long text tutorial first先看一大段文字教程
  • Make them watch a 2-minute video让他们看 2 分钟视频
  • Hide it and hope they discover it藏起来，指望他们自己发现
WHY Learning by doing beats reading; a guided first success teaches fastest. 做中学胜过阅读，一次被引导的成功最快教会人。
#8 CORE DESIGN BASIC 1.8
ART TO GENERATE
Win and lose states in a game should be…
游戏的胜利/失败状态应当……
  • ✓ Immediately clear and unambiguous to the player对玩家即时、清晰、无歧义
  • Subtle and easy to miss微妙、容易被忽略
  • Only shown in a menu只在菜单里显示
  • Decided by the developer afterwards由开发者事后判定
WHY Players must always know if they're winning or losing — feedback drives action. 玩家必须随时知道自己是赢是输——反馈驱动行动。
#9 INTERACTION BASIC 2.1
ART TO GENERATE
An "affordance" in UI design is…
UI 设计中的「可供性 (affordance)」是指……
  • ✓ A property that suggests how an element can be used暗示元素该如何被使用的属性
  • The cost of a feature某功能的成本
  • A loading animation加载动画
  • A type of font一种字体
WHY A button that looks pressable affords pressing. Signifiers make affordances visible. 看起来能按的按钮就"可供"按压；signifier 让可供性可见。
#10 INTERACTION ADVANCED 2.2
Fitts's Law implies that a tap target should be…
Fitts 定律意味着点击目标应当……
  • ✓ Bigger and/or closer to be faster to hit更大、更近，从而更快命中
  • Always in the exact center永远放在正中心
  • The same color as the background跟背景同色
  • Hidden until hovered悬停前隐藏
WHY Time to target ∝ distance / size. Big, near targets are fast. 命中时间正比于距离/尺寸，大而近的目标更快。
#11 INTERACTION ADVANCED 2.3
ART TO GENERATE
Hick's Law suggests that adding more options to a menu…
Hick 定律表明，给菜单增加更多选项会……
  • ✓ Increases the time to decide增加做决定的时间
  • Has no effect on decision time对决策时间没有影响
  • Always improves usability总能提升可用性
  • Reduces the time to decide缩短做决定的时间
WHY Decision time grows with the number of choices — fewer, clearer options win. 决策时间随选项数量增长——更少更清晰的选项更优。
#12 INTERACTION BASIC 2.4
ART TO GENERATE
On touch screens, a comfortable minimum tap-target size is roughly…
触屏上，舒适的最小点击目标尺寸大约是……
  • ✓ 44 px (~iOS HIG)44 像素（约 iOS 规范）
  • 8 px8 像素
  • 16 px16 像素
  • 200 px200 像素
WHY ~44pt/48dp is the common floor so fingers don't mis-tap. 约 44pt/48dp 是常见下限，避免手指误触。
#13 INTERACTION ADVANCED 2.5
ART TO GENERATE
Roughly how long can UI feedback be delayed before it stops feeling "instant"?
UI 反馈延迟大约超过多少，就不再感觉是「即时」的？
  • ✓ ~100 ms约 100 毫秒
  • ~1 second约 1 秒
  • ~3 seconds约 3 秒
  • ~10 seconds约 10 秒
WHY ~0.1s feels instant; ~1s keeps flow; >10s loses attention. 约 0.1 秒感觉即时，约 1 秒维持心流，超 10 秒注意力流失。
#14 INTERACTION ADVANCED 2.6
ART TO GENERATE
Jakob's Law states that users…
Jakob 定律指出，用户……
  • ✓ Expect your product to work like the other products they already know期望你的产品像他们已熟悉的其他产品一样运作
  • Always prefer brand-new interaction patterns总是偏好全新的交互模式
  • Never read any text从不读任何文字
  • Want maximum customization想要最大程度的自定义
WHY Lean on familiar conventions; novelty for its own sake costs usability. 借力熟悉的约定，为新而新会牺牲可用性。
#15 INTERACTION BASIC 2.7
ART TO GENERATE
A good error message should mainly…
一条好的错误提示主要应当……
  • ✓ Explain what happened and how to recover说明发生了什么以及如何恢复
  • Blame the user责怪用户
  • Show a raw error code only只显示一串原始错误码
  • Disappear instantly瞬间消失
WHY Errors should be clear, blameless, and recoverable. 错误提示应清晰、不指责、可恢复。
#16 GAME FEEL BASIC 3.1
ART TO GENERATE
"Easing" in animation refers to…
动画里的「缓动 (easing)」是指……
  • ✓ Varying speed over time instead of moving linearly速度随时间变化，而非匀速直线运动
  • Lowering the resolution降低分辨率
  • Muting the sound静音
  • Reducing the frame rate降低帧率
WHY Ease-in/out makes motion feel natural; linear feels robotic. 缓入缓出让运动自然，匀速显得机械。
#17 GAME FEEL BASIC 3.2
"Screenshake" is mainly used to…
「震屏 (screenshake)」主要用来……
  • ✓ Amplify the sense of impact放大打击/冲击感
  • Save battery省电
  • Reduce file size减小文件体积
  • Translate text翻译文本
WHY A few frames of shake on impact sells weight and force. 命中瞬间几帧抖动能传达重量与力量。
#18 GAME FEEL ADVANCED 3.3
ART TO GENERATE
Anticipation and follow-through (12 animation principles) help by…
预备动作与跟随动作（动画 12 原则）的作用是……
  • ✓ Making motion read clearly and feel weighty让运动易读、有重量感
  • Increasing the polygon count增加多边形数量
  • Encrypting the assets加密资源
  • Adding more menus增加菜单
WHY A small wind-up + overshoot makes actions legible and alive. 小幅蓄力+回弹让动作清晰且有生命力。
#19 GAME FEEL ADVANCED 3.4
ART TO GENERATE
When should you give immediate audio/visual feedback for a tap?
点击操作的音/画反馈应在何时给出？
  • ✓ On the press, before the result resolves在按下那一刻，先于结果产生
  • Only after a network round-trip等网络往返之后
  • Only at the end of the session只在整局结束时
  • Never, to keep it clean永远不给，保持干净
WHY Instant feedback on press confirms the input even if the result lags. 按下即反馈，即使结果有延迟也先确认了输入。
#20 GAME FEEL ADVANCED 3.5
ART TO GENERATE
"Hit-stop" (a brief freeze on impact) is used to…
「顿帧 (hit-stop)」（命中瞬间短暂定格）用来……
  • ✓ Emphasize the weight and impact of a hit强调一次命中的重量与冲击
  • Save memory节省内存
  • Hide a bug掩盖 bug
  • Skip a frame to run faster跳帧以提速
WHY A few frames of freeze on impact makes hits feel powerful. 命中时定格几帧，让打击感更有力量。
#21 GAME FEEL BASIC 3.6
ART TO GENERATE
Particle effects in games primarily serve to…
游戏里的粒子特效主要用来……
  • ✓ Reinforce feedback and make events feel alive强化反馈、让事件更有生命力
  • Increase the download size on purpose故意增大下载体积
  • Replace the core mechanic取代核心机制
  • Slow the game down intentionally故意拖慢游戏
WHY Particles are feedback garnish — they amplify, they aren't the dish. 粒子是反馈的点缀——用来放大，而非主菜。
#22 FEED UX BASIC 4.1
ART TO GENERATE
Designing for a vertical scroll-feed, you should assume the user…
为竖向信息流设计时，应假设用户……
  • ✓ Arrives with zero context and almost no patience带着零上下文、近乎零耐心进来
  • Has read a manual first已经先读过说明书
  • Will replay daily without prompting会每天主动回访
  • Wants to configure settings before playing想先配置设置再玩
WHY No rules to learn, no choices before play, instant feedback. 没有要学的规则，玩前不做选择，即点即有反馈。
#23 FEED UX BASIC 4.2
ART TO GENERATE
A "self-explanatory UI" means…
「自解释的 UI」意味着……
  • ✓ The interface teaches itself through visuals, not text walls界面靠视觉自我教学，而非大段文案
  • It comes with a long PDF manual配一份长 PDF 手册
  • It requires a video tutorial需要看视频教程
  • It only works for returning users只对回访用户有效
WHY Show, don't tell — affordances over instructions. 用展示代替讲解，可供性优于说明文字。
#24 FEED UX ADVANCED 4.3
ART TO GENERATE
For a feed mini-game, designing for "one-shot" play rather than retention means…
为信息流小游戏做「一次性」而非「留存」设计，意味着……
  • ✓ The first encounter must be complete and satisfying on its own第一次相遇本身就要完整且满足
  • Locking content behind daily streaks用每日连击锁住内容
  • Requiring an account to start开始前要求注册
  • Front-loading a long tutorial前置一段长教程
WHY Assume no return visit; make the single session pay off. 别假设回访，让单局本身就值回票价。
#25 FEED UX BASIC 4.5
ART TO GENERATE
On a large phone held one-handed, the easiest area for the thumb to reach is…
单手握持大屏手机时，拇指最易触达的区域是……
  • ✓ The lower-center of the screen屏幕的下方中部
  • The top corners顶部两角
  • The very top edge最顶边
  • Off-screen屏幕之外
WHY Put primary actions in the thumb zone (bottom), not the top corners. 把主要操作放在拇指区（底部），别放顶角。
#26 FEED UX ADVANCEDMULTI 4.6
ART TO GENERATE
Which of these make a feed mini-game graspable in seconds? (Select all)
以下哪些能让信息流小游戏在几秒内被看懂？（多选）
  • ✓ No rules to learn before playing玩之前没有规则要学
  • ✓ Self-explanatory, visual UI自解释的视觉化 UI
  • ✓ Instant feedback on the first tap第一次点击就有即时反馈
  • A mandatory settings step first先来一个强制设置步骤
  • A required signup强制注册
WHY The first three reduce time-to-understand; settings and signup add friction before the fun. 前三项缩短理解时间，设置和注册在乐趣前增加摩擦。
#27 SOCIAL BASIC 6.1
ART TO GENERATE
In a UGC social game, "a feed needs a verb" means…
UGC 社交游戏里「feed needs a verb（信息流需要一个动词）」是指……
  • ✓ Viewers need an action to take on content, which notifies the author观众需要一个能对内容施加的动作，且会通知作者
  • Every post must contain a verb in its title每条内容标题里必须含动词
  • The feed should scroll automatically信息流应自动滚动
  • Authors should post more often作者应更频繁地发帖
WHY A passive feed dies; a verb (kept/popped/remixed) creates a loop back to the author. 纯被动的 feed 会死，一个动词会把价值回流给作者，形成循环。
#28 SOCIAL ADVANCED 6.2
ART TO GENERATE
A healthy social notification (e.g. "X reacted to your work") should…
一条健康的社交通知（如「X 对你的作品有反应」）应当……
  • ✓ Be triggered by another real user acting on your content, with self-guard & dedupe由其他真实用户对你的内容操作触发，并做自我屏蔽与去重
  • Be sent to yourself for your own actions因你自己的操作而发给自己
  • Repeat every minute regardless of activity不论是否有活动每分钟重复
  • Come from fabricated fake users来自编造的假用户
WHY Notify on others' actions; never self-notify; never fake users. 因他人操作而通知，不自我通知，不用假用户。
#29 SOCIAL ADVANCED 6.3
ART TO GENERATE
For a social game's cold-start (no real users yet), the best fallback is…
社交游戏冷启动（还没有真实用户）时，最佳兜底是……
  • ✓ A real subject that needs no fake identity (e.g. "you vs. your AI self")不需要假身份的真实主体（如「你 vs 你的 AI 分身」）
  • Auto-generated fake user profiles自动生成的假用户资料
  • An empty screen一个空白屏
  • Copying another app's user list抄另一个 app 的用户列表
WHY Fake users are dead-ends that expose the fake; use a real, safe subject. 假用户是会暴露的死路，用真实、安全的主体兜底。
#30 SOCIAL BASIC 6.4
ART TO GENERATE
"Virality" in a product loop usually comes from…
产品循环里的「病毒性」通常来自……
  • ✓ Each user's action naturally surfacing the product to new users每个用户的行为自然把产品带到新用户面前
  • Buying more ads买更多广告
  • A bigger app icon更大的应用图标
  • Longer loading screens更长的加载页
WHY Built-in sharing as a side effect of normal use beats paid acquisition. 把分享内建为正常使用的副产品，胜过付费获取。
#31 SOCIAL BASIC 6.5
ART TO GENERATE
A "leaderboard rivalry" notification (e.g. "X just beat your score") works because it…
「排行榜对手」通知（如「X 刚超过了你的分数」）有效，是因为它……
  • ✓ Gives the beaten player a reason to come back and reclaim their spot给被超过的玩家一个回来夺回名次的理由
  • Spams everyone equally平等地骚扰所有人
  • Hides the score隐藏分数
  • Deletes the leaderboard删除排行榜
WHY Competition + a personal stake pulls the rival back into the loop. 竞争+切身利害把对手重新拉回循环。
#32 SOCIAL ADVANCED 6.6
ART TO GENERATE
Retention and virality differ in that…
留存与病毒性的区别在于……
  • ✓ Retention brings the same users back; virality brings new users in留存让同一批用户回来，病毒性带来新用户
  • They mean exactly the same thing二者意思完全相同
  • Virality only matters for paid ads病毒性只对付费广告有意义
  • Retention only matters on launch day留存只在上线当天有意义
WHY Different loops: retention = come-back, virality = bring-a-friend. 两套循环：留存=回来，病毒性=带朋友来。
